shorts.description: Wait, WHAT?! I had to read that twice. When you skip sleep, your brain's cleanup crew goes rogue and starts chewing up HEALTHY brain connections. Your own brain. Eating itself. Because you stayed up scrolling. Twenty watts of pure chaos sitting in your skull right now. Which body part do YOU think is the weirdest? Full 7-fact battle on the channel!
shorts.title: Your Brain EATS ITSELF When You Skip Sleep?! #shorts #facts #weirdfacts

shorts.description: Your stomach acid is strong enough to dissolve solid METAL — and the only reason you're not digesting yourself alive is that your stomach builds a brand-new protective lining every 3-4 days. Twice a week! A metal-melting acid bath that rebuilds itself like it's absolutely nothing. Nature is unhinged. Full 7-fact battle on the channel!
shorts.title: Your Stomach Could Dissolve METAL?! #shorts #facts #weirdfacts

shorts.description: Okay, this broke my brain. Unwind the DNA from ONE cell and it stretches about 2 meters. Do it for all 37 trillion cells and it reaches the SUN and back... more than 200 times. Your personal space program, hiding in every cell. And you share 99.9% of it with every stranger you pass on the street. Awkward. Full 7-fact battle on the channel!
shorts.title: Your DNA Reaches the Sun... 200 TIMES?! #shorts #facts #weirdfacts
